```{r}
#| label: wall-setup
#| include: false

library(showtext)
library(ggplot2)

font_add_google("Lato", "Lato")
font_add_google("Alegreya", "Alegreya")

showtext_auto()

theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 12, base_family = "Lato"))

theme_update(
  plot.title = element_text(family = "Alegreya", face = "bold", size = 16),
  plot.caption = element_text(family = "Alegreya", size = 12)
)

update_geom_defaults("text", list(family = "Lato"))
update_geom_defaults("label", list(family = "Lato"))
```
